WHAT_THIS_IS.purpose: the single ladder run 理 ruled (11052): it NAMES the rung in Stockfish Elo so the P8 table's figures stop reading as ratings. No prior, 256 sims, 60 games per rung, one rung (1500) plus a random-mover anchor.
WHAT_THIS_IS.the_rung: the P8 BASELINE — frozen conv_value_llm1, no prior, 256 sims — plays at ~1983 Elo (+/- 73). The raw policy with no search plays at ~1802 (+/- 73).
WHAT_THIS_IS.so_the_P8_table_reads: WITH-256's +30 Elo sits around 2013; WITH-64's -168 around 1815; WITHOUT-64's -215 around 1768. Those are anchored figures, not ratings in their own right.
WHAT_THIS_IS.the_closed_loop_gain_is_a_free_by_produc: +182 Elo from adding 256-simulation MCTS to the raw policy. For scale: the PRIOR's effect across the whole P8 sweep was 0.03 +- 0.08 of win rate, about +20 +- 55 Elo. Search is worth nine times what the prior is worth, and the prior's interval includes zero.
bounds: +/- 73 on the rung is comparable to the P8 deltas themselves (SE 0.079 of win rate ~= +/- 55 Elo). The rung ANCHORS the table; it does not sharpen it.

One rung (1500) plus a random anchor. A three-rung ladder would tighten the margin; I ran one rung because eval_search.py writes only at the end and a multi-hour run risks producing no artifact at all.
Stockfish UCI_Elo at 0.05s movetime is not a FIDE rating and these figures inherit whatever that mapping is worth.
